versions.finding: Axe reported a brand visible-name/accessibility-name mismatch. Visual inspection also showed Read record cues were not separate actionable controls. One focused navigation semantics correction removed the redundant brand aria-label, added content whitespace, made Read record a real button, and replaced the decorative back glyph with inline SVG to remove an automated contrast incomplete finding.

checks.evidenceScope: Screenshots named natural capture the post-action viewport without scrolling to the top for capture. Full-page captures are separately named and do not establish initial viewport visibility. Source inspection is separate from these executed rendered checks.
failuresObserved: First WSL launcher command returned Wsl/E_ACCESSDENIED; identical read succeeded with tool sandbox escalation.
Tool availability probe found no system chromium command and no @playwright directory; the installed playwright package and its bundled browser were available.
Initial browser harness used browser.newPage(); axe rejected it with Please use browser.newContext(). Raw failure retained; harness corrected before full scan.

First complete scan reported label-content-name-mismatch on the brand link at all three widths. Detail scans had color-contrast incomplete for a decorative arrow. Both resolved in version 01; final scans had zero violations/incomplete.
First creator-record writer failed before writing with NameError: name true is not defined. Corrected using JSON serialization.
unavailableOrUnassessed: Every record detail at every width; the longest supplied EL-03 record was rendered and asserted
remainingObservations: At 390px the fiction ribbon uses a narrow text column beside the metadata count. It wraps without overflow; further aesthetic adjustment was outside the single correction pass.
